objective: Verify an isolated candidate artifact using verifier-owned deterministic checks and produce independent decision support.

context.summary: Executable verifier MVP fixture for issue #5. The worker may produce candidate.json but may not control verifier code or verifier policy.

outputs.description: An isolated JSON candidate evaluated by an independent local verifier.

policies: Candidate cannot modify verifier code or verifier-owned policy
Verification success is decision support, not merge authority

uncertainty.statement: This deterministic JSON fixture is intentionally smaller than the repository-level verifier required for the full issue #5 benchmark cohort.
uncertainty.resolution_strategy: Use the same verifier contract on bounded repository candidates after the canonical node Docker acceptance gate is satisfied.

security.notes: The verifier parses isolated fixture JSON only and does not execute candidate-supplied code.

verification_policy.acceptance_rule: Artifact digest, candidate scope, and verifier-owned acceptance checks must all pass.

validators.description: Observed candidate bytes must match the worker ResultManifest artifact digest.
The isolated candidate directory may contain only verifier-policy-approved files.
Verifier-owned deterministic expectations must pass independently of worker self-report.

evidence_requirements.description: Record the observed SHA-256 of the candidate artifact.
Record verifier-owned acceptance-check evidence and diagnostics.
